text:
Picture a physio clinic in Joondalup. Open till 5 on Saturdays.

Google says it shuts at 3.

Anyone searching "physio open now Joondalup" at 4pm is told it's closed. They don't ring to check. They book the next clinic on the map.

Search your own business on Google once a week.

"I'll sort out our Google listing over the Christmas break." (famous last words)

Every year someone tells me that. Every January it's still not done.

Checking your hours, phone number and photos takes about an hour.

Do it this week, before the Christmas rush.

My first website had beautiful fonts. Zero calls.

Google ranks a page on whether it says what people search for, like "brake repairs Osborne Park". Design only breaks a tie.

Words first. Design last.
